findings.priority_reason: Changes the conditional logic for displaying environment variable hints in CLI error messages, preventing potential errors or invalid output when the environment variable is not defined.
findings.title: Conditional suppression of environment variable hints in error messages
findings.before: The error hint included the env var string even if self.envvar was None.
findings.after: The error hint only includes the env var string if both self.show_envvar is truthy and self.envvar is not None.
findings.scenario: A parameter is configured to show environment variables but has no associated environment variable name.
findings.example_before: Invalid value for --option (env var: 'None'): bad input
findings.potential_impact: Users will see cleaner error messages; existing logic relying on the presence of the 'None' literal in the error output may break if it parses error strings.
findings.review_question: Does any part of the application suite depend on parsing the literal string 'None' inside the error hint when self.envvar is unset?

example.input: A parameter is configured to show environment variables but has no associated environment variable name.
example.base_outcome: Invalid value for --option (env var: 'None'): bad input
